name: @gltf-studio/play
description: PlayController implementation (specs/engine-api.md PC-001..PC-009): runs the document's KHR_interactivity graph against the interpreter (@gltfi/runtime) or compiled (@gltfi/runtime-lib + @gltfi/ir + @gltfi/emit-ts) engine, fanning outgoing pointer writes out to RenderHost/AudioHost. PC-009 (docs/adr/0006) adds an optional debug compiled-play pipeline: the exact flavor-TS text @gltf-studio/script-panel's Script tab shows, transformed via esbuild-wasm into JS + a real inline source map, loaded under a stable virtual sourceURL for real DevTools debugging.
